headline: The site says Alpine P.O. Box. Google pins the yard on Olde Hwy 80 in El Cajon.
summary: This is a real independent C-27 landscape and hardscape shop, started in 2014 by Chris and Audra Burgio. Google Maps is live this week, Open, at about 4.8 stars, with Friday hours of 7 to 3:30. Yahoo prints Monday through Friday 7 to 3:30, Saturday and Sunday closed, at 5.0 stars from 41 reviews. The shop prints (619) 277-1399 and cburgio@burgiolandscape.com on every page. The site only prints P.O. Box 422, Alpine, CA 91903. Google, Yahoo, and BBB put the shop at 15702 Olde Hwy 80, El Cajon, CA 92021. A neighbor searching Alpine landscaping sees an El Cajon pin and can wonder if it is the same crew.

signals.note: You show up for landscaping in the Alpine and El Cajon hills. Google Maps is live this week, Open, at about 4.8 stars. Yahoo shows 5.0 stars from 41 reviews, with notes into July 2026. BBB lists you as accredited. A neighbor looking for irrigation, cleanups, or a new yard can find you.
signals.next: Keep the category landscaper on Google. Keep answering reviews as the owner, the way you already do.

signals.note: The number (619) 277-1399 is consistent on the site, Google, Yahoo, BBB, and Opendi. cburgio@burgiolandscape.com sits in clear text at the bottom of every page on the site. One phone and one inbox is exactly right.
signals.next: Keep (619) 277-1399 and cburgio@burgiolandscape.com on every listing. Copy them the same morning if either ever changes.

signals.note: Google shows Open today, Friday 7 to 3:30. Yahoo prints Monday through Friday 7 to 3:30, Saturday and Sunday closed. The site does not print a week anywhere. A neighbor who only opens the site cannot tell when the office picks up.
signals.next: Put one small hour card (Monday through Friday 7 to 3:30, weekends closed) in the site footer next to the phone.

signals.note: The site has a real gallery plus curb and turf before and after pages. The newest uploads on those pages date to early 2024. Google has customer photos into July 2026. This year's patios, walls, and turf are thinner on the site than the work deserves.
signals.next: Add a handful of 2025 and 2026 jobs to the gallery. Drop the same few onto Google so both look like this season.

signals.note: burgiolandscape.com loads and belongs to you. Services, financing, reviews, before and after pages, employment, the C-27 license story, phone, and inbox are all there. The brochure is alive and easy to use.
signals.next: Keep the phone and inbox in the footer. Add the hour card and one line about the towns you serve.

signals.note: Phone lines up everywhere: (619) 277-1399. The site only prints P.O. Box 422, Alpine, CA 91903, and titles itself Landscape Design Alpine CA. Google, Yahoo, and BBB put the shop at 15702 Olde Hwy 80, El Cajon, CA 92021. BBB carries both. Two town stories is how a neighbor in Alpine wonders if the El Cajon pin is the same crew.
signals.next: Pick one line and use it everywhere, for example based at 15702 Olde Hwy 80, El Cajon, serving Alpine and East County. Put that same line on the site footer.
